definitions.interval_s: Difference between consecutive original logged call timestamps. Includes elapsed algorithm/Objective work; not an isolated physics-kernel timing.
definitions.feasible: Original known feasibility true and finite logged loss.
definitions.plateau: Consecutive logged calls after first feasibility without a strictly lower logged feasible loss.
definitions.mode: Joined only when an actual per-call diagnostic record agrees on call, loss and feasibility; otherwise unknown.
definitions.control_receipts: Saved aggregate control outcomes remain context; absent control trajectories are never interpolated.

pilot_summary.pilot: v7 paired 099-vs-096 on topologies {10,11,12}, seed 42, 180 s, alternating order
pilot_summary.boundary: ORGANIZER_PUBLIC_DEVELOPMENT measurement on public UIFOProblems; NOT an official score, entry, award or payment claim, and not H100 parity.
pilot_summary.interpretation: Single-cell paired outcomes are development observations. GPU floating-point nondeterminism is a plausible explanation for small paired trajectory differences — plausible, not causally instrumented and not a proven noise band. 096 is the timing-matched control; 099 changes acceptance to feasibility-ranked anchor/backtracking. No improvement claim rests on single pairs.
pilot_summary.static_contract: accepted local passes carried as metadata; not re-run in cloud

paired_result.note: negative delta = lower measured feasible loss for 099 on this pair; the three-pair sample does not establish general superiority

baseline_reused_from.reuse_conditions: Same exact 096 source, c030 runner, T4, Python/JAX/JAXlib/NumPy/dfbench/Differometor versions, x64, public T7/T8/T9, seed42 and 180s; controls not rerun.
